facts.fact: TTCL's Director General said in November 2025 that 11 international submarine cable connections already terminate through Dar es Salaam and Mombasa, including SEACOM, EASSy and 2Africa (count spans both ports; the document does not split it between Tanzania and Kenya).

systems.country_label: Kilimanjaro One Submarine Cable System; planned, 1,900 km Dar es Salaam to Mauritius with branches to Unguja and Mafia, construction 2026, completion late 2027
